notes: Rules for the gates every raw hit passes before deduplication. Hits on Natural Resources Wales (NRW) own domains are dropped, because the register tracks external signals only. A hit from an untrusted or unknown source survives the relevance gate only if its title, snippet or URL carries a relevance token as a whole word or phrase. The tokens are the words below plus the English and Welsh names of every place of the listed kinds in config/reference/places.json; a river drops its River or Afon prefix, so River Dee gives dee.
